第94章 河边抓奸，广播站的-《赶山1957：二斤猪肉换个媳妇》

上一章

存书签

然而。

老娘韩秀话音刚落，李青山眼睛就瞪得老大道：“娘，不行啊，房间那么小，肯定睡得不舒坦。”

开啥玩笑？

自己一个血气方刚的小伙子，晚上还打算去找柔雪解闷呢！

老娘，这不是坑你家儿子吗？

“小什么小，肯定能睡得下！”

“行了，我先抱小草去房间。”

老娘韩秀倒是很喜欢嘴甜的小草，小心的抱着小草朝着房间内走了过去。

“明日再折腾吧，你也歇歇！”柔雪安慰道。

“唉！”

李青山望着柔雪的背影，忍不住长叹一口气。

得！！

那就攒到明日再说吧。

李青山则是将院子里一个水桶盖掀开，里面放着鱼肠子和内脏之类的东西，血呼呼的，这些都是自己特意留下来的。

先用绳子将肠子内脏系起来，每一个都有鹅蛋大小，然后绑在地笼子里面，大概三十多个，李青山一个人也装不过来，老爹就过来帮忙一起装了半个小时才完事。

全部装在麻袋里面，用扁担挑着，一个人摸着黑，便朝着大河的方向赶了过去。

等到将地笼子全部下好后，大概也就是晚上九点钟。

等到明天早晨三点多还要起床电鱼，电完后估计就五点多了，然后推着板车去卖鱼之前将这些地笼子从河水中拽上来，希望能捕到几只王八，也好去林业站走走关系不是？

“爹，真没办法走走关系，把我那几个兄弟也放出来？”

“你个瘪犊子，能让你出来已经是老子送了不少东西，用了不少人情，你可就知足吧，你那几个兄弟要是不进去呆今天，也不好交代。”

“娘的，就让李青山那小子再得瑟三天吧！

“行了，这两天你给我老老实实呆在家里，不要出去乱跑！”

“娘的，这次等老子把这小鳖犊子脚筋给挑断，看这小子还怎么勾搭我媳妇春晓！”

黑夜中。

李青山躲在一处树后，听到路过赵支书和赵霸的声音后，眼神中流露出一抹冷意，本以为赵霸这个家伙要进去几天，没想到今天就给放出来了，看来赵支书为了自家儿子，出了不少的力气。

挑断自己的脚筋！

赵家这对父子，还真是好狠毒的心肠。

自己就靠着上山打猎这营生过日子，要是将自己脚筋挑断，自己还怎么上山打猎？

However.

As soon as my mother Han Xiu finished speaking, Li Qingshan's eyes widened and he said, "Mom, no, the room is so small, I'm sure it won't be comfortable for me to sleep."

Are you kidding me?

I am a hot-blooded young man, and I plan to go to Rouxue to relieve my boredom at night!

Mom, isn’t this cheating your son?

"You're so small, you can definitely sleep on it!"

"Okay, I'll take Xiaocao to the room first."

My mother, Han Xiu, liked the sweet-tongued Xiaocao very much, so she carefully carried Xiaocao towards the room.

"Let's keep working on it tomorrow, and you should take a rest!" Rouxue comforted.

"Alas!"

Li Qingshan looked at Rouxue's back and couldn't help but sigh.

have to!!

Then save it until tomorrow.

Li Qingshan opened the lid of a bucket in the yard, and there were things like fish intestines and internal organs inside, which were full of blood. These were all kept by him on purpose.

First, the intestines and internal organs were tied up with ropes. Each one was about the size of a goose egg, and then tied into a cage on the ground. There were about thirty of them. Li Qingshan couldn't fit them in by himself, so his father came over to help and they worked together for half an hour before they were done.

They were all put in sacks and carried on poles. One person groped in the dark and hurried towards the river.

After all the cages are put down, it will be about nine o'clock in the evening.

I have to get up at around 3 o'clock tomorrow morning to electro-fish. It will be around 5 o'clock after the electricity is finished. Then I will pull these cages up from the river before pushing the trolley to sell the fish. I hope to catch a few tortoises and go to the forestry station for a walk, right?

"Dad, if you really can't let go of the relationship, let those brothers of mine be released too?"

"You little brat, I've given you a lot of gifts and used a lot of favors to get you out, so just be satisfied. If your brothers don't stay here today, it won't be easy."

"Damn it, let that kid Li Qingshan have fun for three more days!

"Okay, stay at home for these two days and don't go out and run around!"

"Damn, wait until I break this little turtle's hamstrings this time, and see how this kid seduces my wife Chunxiao!"

In the dark night.

Li Qingshan hid behind a tree. When he heard the voices of Party Secretary Zhao and Zhao Ba passing by, there was a hint of coldness in his eyes. He thought that Zhao Ba would go in for a few days, but he didn't expect that he would be released today. It seemed that Party Secretary Zhao had put in a lot of effort for his son.

Break your own hamstring!

The father and son of the Zhao family are really cruel-hearted.

He makes a living by hunting in the mountains. If his hamstring is broken, how can he go hunting in the mountains?
